found_values.value: A 5 V linear regulator of its own for the 3 bridges, which also supplies the bridge ADC's analogue supply (AVDD), fed from the board's selected input bus (6.0 to 20 V, R5 row; up to 22 V while V84 is open). Not the IO board's 5 V rail, which carries the display's 1.5 A continuous and 2 A peak and whose tolerance at the IO board's own loads is open (V100). The bridge is excited from the ADC's own 5 V analogue supply and the excitation sense lines go to the ADC's reference input, so the measurement is ratiometric and the excitation's noise and drift cancel. The ADC's AVDD must stay within 4.75 to 5.25 V

These are the published ranges of the commercial thrust stand whose electrical class matches this bench: Tyto Robotics Flight Stand 50, voltage up to 180 V and current up to 300 A. found_values.value: Thrust cell: 0.05 N. Each torque cell: 1/10,000 of the torque range (Flight Stand 50: 0.003 N·m over ±30 N·m); in N not read, because the torque cells' capacity is not read (V257). Flight Stand 50 defines resolution as 3 times the standard deviation of the noise floor over a 1 s static recording at the full sample rate. On the 980.7 N, 2.0 mV/V thrust cell at 5.0 V (10.0 mV at capacity), 0.05 N is 0.510 µV at the ADC input, so the thrust channel's input-referred noise is at most 0.170 µV RMS at the output rate of V261. A torque cell whose capacity equals the force at 30 N·m needs at most 0.333 µV RMS (1/10,000 of 10.0 mV, divided by 3); a larger torque cell tightens that in proportion
found_values.source: Flight Stand 50 Datasheet FSFI50 V5.1, Product Specifications (Thrust Resolution 0.05 N, Torque Resolution 0.003 Nm) and Technical definitions (Resolution), https://cdn.tytorobotics.com/Documents/Datasheets/Flight-Stand-50-Datasheet.pdf; V256, V257

found_values.value: 0.51 % of the cell's rated output, applied to every channel, over 0 to 50 °C (V264), after one calibration at one temperature. Flight Stand 50 Standard gives thrust ±5 N over ±500 N, which is 0.51 % of the 980.7 N thrust cell's rated output, and torque ±0.4 N·m over ±30 N·m (1.33 % of the range); the torque figure in % of a torque cell's rated output is not read (V257), so the thrust figure applies to all 3. Both are whole-system figures after Tyto's calibration. With ratiometric measurement (V254) the excitation's gain error and drift cancel, so the bridge ADC's offset and gain drift over ±25 K from a 25 °C calibration carry the budget: 0.51 % of 10.0 mV is 51 µV
found_values.source: Flight Stand 50 Datasheet FSFI50 V5.1, Product Specifications (Thrust Accuracy ±5 N Standard; Torque Accuracy ±0.4 Nm Standard), Technical definitions (Accuracy) and Calibration and Verification, https://cdn.tytorobotics.com/Documents/Datasheets/Flight-Stand-50-Datasheet.pdf; V257, V254

The board senses the reference at its own excitation terminals, and one reference input serves all 3 cells, because they share one excitation (V254). A 6-wire cell connects with its sense leads joined to its excitation leads at the connector
